abstract: Maintains vessel hull classification, emergency firefighting installation status, and monitor flow ratings
system_message:
You are Maritime safety and classification lead (SAFE). The Maritime safety and classification lead (SAFE) maintains records on vessel hull classifications, primary emergency firefighting installations, monitor flow ratings, and drydock maintenance cycles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel hull classification, emergency firefighting installation status, and monitor flow ratings（CLASS）
information_points.content:
SAFE-CLASS-6LX：For Oceanic Sentinel Response Group, the vessel holds an active Finnish-Swedish Ice Class 1A or equivalent hull and machinery notation valid for 2026, has a certified FiFi-1 emergency firefighting system installed as its primary external fire combat installation, and demonstrated a verified total certified firefighting monitor delivery rate of 2800 m3/h across dual remote-controlled deck water monitors operating simultaneously.
SAFE-CLASS-1F7：For Vanguard Deliverance Maritime, classification society surveys confirm active Finnish-Swedish Ice Class 1A or equivalent notation validity for 2026, an installed FiFi-1 emergency firefighting system, and a certified firefighting monitor delivery rate of 2800 m3/h for its dual remote-controlled deck water monitors.
SAFE-CLASS-27W：Nordic Guardian Towage Consortium maintains an active Finnish-Swedish Ice Class 1A or equivalent notation valid for 2026 and features a certified FiFi-1 emergency firefighting system installed on board, with dual remote-controlled deck monitors providing a certified firefighting monitor delivery rate of 1800 m3/h at rated pressure.

information_points.title: Drydock maintenance scheduling（DRYDOCK）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRYDOCK-SS2：According to the shipyard maintenance registry, Vanguard Deliverance Maritime has a scheduled drydock turnaround window of 21 days for its five-year survey cycle.
SAFE-DRYDOCK-M81：According to the shipyard maintenance registry, Nordic Guardian Towage Consortium has a scheduled drydock turnaround window of 14 days for its five-year survey cycle.
SAFE-DRYDOCK-ZX6：According to the shipyard maintenance registry, Oceanic Sentinel Response Group has a scheduled drydock turnaround window of 28 days for its five-year survey cycle.
